research_findings: Identified that static generation for `/sitemap.xml` was failing during the Next.js build (`ECONNREFUSED` on database query) because it was not explicitly marked as dynamic.
Identified that `preferReducedMotion` in `AdaptiveCoachDemo.tsx` was causing React to throw a `react-hooks/refs` error (cannot access refs during render).
features_improved: Added `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` to `src/app/sitemap.ts` to prevent build-time database connection errors.
Replaced `useRef` with `useState` for `preferReducedMotion` and properly updated its dependency array in the `useEffect` hooks.
new_features_added: No new capabilities were added in this run; focus was on improving resilience and fixing build errors.
next_steps_for_next_run: Investigate replacing native `fetch` calls with `fetchWithRetry` in non-UI modules (e.g., `cloudinary-upload-client.ts`, `analytics-client.ts`).
Address Vitest warnings regarding React `act(...)` in `DiagramCanvas.test.tsx` and `FeedbackModal.defend.test.tsx`.
